# Copilot instructions

## Project

This repository contains the source content for josuenavarro.com, a bilingual personal and commercial website for Josue Navarro, a CTO and technology advisor.

## Content rules

- Treat `josuenavarro_web_content_bilingual.md` as the source of truth for website copy.
- Preserve the Spanish and English versions together. When changing one language, update its paired section in the other language.
- Keep the positioning focused on technology strategy, scalable architecture, cloud, engineering effectiveness, and responsible AI adoption.
- Do not invent metrics, testimonials, client logos, employers, certifications, outcomes, or other credentials. Flag unsupported claims instead.
- Keep claims specific, credible, and consistent with the editorial criterion in the source document.
- Preserve the existing Markdown hierarchy and section organization unless the task explicitly requests a structural change.
- Use clear, polished professional language. Avoid hype, vague buzzwords, and unnecessary jargon.
- Keep calls to action, navigation labels, SEO metadata, and other repeated copy consistent across the two languages.
- Use ASCII punctuation and formatting unless the existing Spanish text requires an accented character.

## Working style

- Make focused edits and avoid changing unrelated sections.
- Before adding new copy, check nearby sections for terminology and tone.
- When a request is ambiguous, state the assumption and identify any factual details that need confirmation.
